# Rejubliss 3D Animation Studios

> Rejubliss is a London-based creative 3D animation, photorealistic CGI, motion graphics, explainer video, website design, and interactive WebGL studio partnering with consumer, luxury, healthcare, hospitality, retail, and technology brands in the UK and worldwide.

- Website: https://www.rejubliss.co.uk
- Company Address: 18 Blythe Wood Court, Waterloo Road, Uxbridge, United Kingdom, UB8 2SP
- Contact Email: info@rejubliss.co.uk
- Studio Telephone: +44 20 8123 4567
- Inquiry & Custom Proposal Form: https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/#contact

## Studio Overview

Rejubliss combines 3D/CGI production craft and real-time browser engineering under a single London studio roof. Teams commission Rejubliss to visualize physical products before manufacturing, produce multi-SKU packaging and out-of-home (OOH) billboard campaigns, explain complex technical or medical concepts through 2D/3D animation, and build fast Next.js + Three.js interactive web experiences.

Every engagement follows a six-stage milestone-gated workflow:
1. Discovery & Brief (scope, aspect ratios, CAD/brand asset review, NDA sign-off)
2. Concept & Direction (moodboards, material studies, lighting styleframes)
3. Storyboard & Design (animatic pacing, 3D clay layout, or UI wireframes)
4. Production & Motion (PBR texturing, Houdini liquid/frost VFX, rigging, raytraced rendering, or Three.js/GLSL development)
5. Review & Refinement (two consolidated feedback rounds per milestone)
6. Final Delivery (4K UHD ProRes/H.264 films, 9:16 & 1:1 social cutdowns, 300 DPI print/OOH TIFF/PNG masters, or production web code & Draco GLB assets)

## Core Creative Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services): Complete index of Rejubliss's 9 specialist disciplines and commissionable deliverables.
- [3D Animation](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/3d-animation): Cinematic 3D product launch films, mechanical cutaways, and raytraced commercial sequences in 4K UHD.
- [CGI & Photorealistic Rendering](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/cgi-rendering): 300 DPI print and OOH billboard key visuals, multi-SKU packaging renders, and physically based surface studies.
- [Product Visualization](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/product-visualization): Studio 3D product twins, liquid/botanical splash VFX, exploded hardware views, and 360-degree e-commerce renders.
- [Motion Graphics](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/motion-graphics): 2D/3D kinetic typography, fluid procedural VFX, broadcast identity packages, paid-social video toolkits, and Lottie UI motion.
- [Explainer Video Production](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/explainer-videos): Script-to-screen 2D, 3D, and hybrid explainer animations for SaaS, FinTech, healthcare/MedTech, and technical products.
- [Character Animation](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/character-animation): Custom 3D and 2D character design, facial/skeletal rigging, brand mascots, and narrative storytelling.
- [Architectural Visualization](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/architectural-visualization): Photorealistic retail storefronts, illuminated signage pre-visualization, transit/mall OOH mockups, and interior/exterior CGI.
- [Website Design](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/website-design): Bespoke Figma UI/UX systems and Core-Web-Vitals-optimized Next.js & TypeScript websites.
- [Interactive WebGL Experiences](https://www.rejubliss.co.uk/services/interactive-webgl): Real-time 60fps Three.js / React Three Fiber 3D product configurators, custom GLSL shaders, and scroll-choreographed 3D microsites.
